description: Entity reaches cloud model in cleartext — encoder failed to mask an EIN. Post-rehydrate hash should not match the key-store key set, triggering detection.
input_text: Please draft a services agreement for Globex Corp (EIN 98-7654321). Our counsel is Jane Doe.
expected_post_rehydrate_text: Please draft a services agreement for Globex Corp (EIN 98-7654321). Our counsel is Jane Doe.
detection: After rehydrate, compare hashes of detected-entity-set vs key_store keys; if cleartext entity slips through, the rehydrate hash will not match.
recovery: Reject the response and re-encode with a stricter prompt.
